_comment: Shared source-of-truth for rebate/STC/price facts that change over time, per the site-loop scorecard's Page 0 requirement. Every page that states one of these figures should match this file. Update the figure, asOf date and source together — never one without the others.

federalBatteryRebate.summary: A federal discount on the upfront cost of an eligible battery system (5-100 kWh usable capacity), applied by the installer at the time of purchase rather than claimed separately afterwards.
federalBatteryRebate.stepDownFrequency: every 6 months until the scheme ends in 2030
federalBatteryRebate.caveat: Indicative only. The exact current rate, eligible battery list and taper depend on installation date and are confirmed by DCCEEW/the Clean Energy Regulator, not by this business. Always confirmed as part of a real quote, never guaranteed upfront by this page.
